title: Store Business Central Telemetry in Azure Application Insights

features.name: Application Insights for Business Central Telemetry
features.description: Azure Application Insights is a service used to store telemetry data from Business Central. It requires provisioning a resource in the Azure portal and configuring it with subscription, resource group, name, and region settings.
caveats: Classic mode is deprecated; workspace-based mode should be used
Deployment takes a few minutes to complete

features.name: Workspace-based Application Insights Mode
features.description: The workspace-based mode is the recommended configuration for Application Insights resources, where the workspace is where the data is actually stored. The classic mode is deprecated.
caveats: Classic mode should not be used
